description: This PHP source file contains the front-end logic and HTML structure for MTA Line Diagnostics configuration and testing in a web-based gateway UI. It includes PHP code, JavaScript, and HTML for initiating diagnostics tests on MTA lines, updating UI elements based on test status, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: Document ready handler
methods.description: Initializes event handlers on page load for starting line diagnostics and updating UI.

methods.name: click handler for #start_diagnostics1
methods.description: Starts the diagnostic test for MTA Line 1, handling off-hook detection and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: click handler for #start_diagnostics2
methods.description: Starts the diagnostic test for MTA Line 2, similar to above.
